description:
IEU UNIVERSITY (PUEBLA, MEXICO) We are a multidisciplinary team of 18- and 19-year-old undergraduate students from IEU University in Puebla, Mexico.
As young Latin American researchers passionate about applied artificial intelligence, and Earth sciences, we built AETHERIS-7 from scratch without institutional supercomputing infrastructure Our goal was to prove that open environmental data—combined with rigorous numerical calculus and low-cost cloud computing—can empower civil protection
